goal: Find additional independent real-photography source pools for the first nudity head without weakening copyright, adulthood, model-rights or source-pool requirements.

findings.creator: Dainis Graveris / FounderTips / SexualAlpha
findings.evidenceSummary: Multiple 2021 lingerie works explicitly say they are released under Creative Commons and ask for credit to Dainis Graveris. Independent Flickr-to-Commons reviews confirm CC BY 2.0 for works from the same published pool. SexualAlpha identifies itself as adult-only content.
findings.rightsFinding: Copyright licensing is promising and much stronger than ordinary Flickr search snippets, but image-level model adulthood and model/personality-rights authorization for Artes moderation ML are not established by the pages reviewed.
findings.nextAction: Seek an explicit model-release/adult-status statement or direct rights-holder confirmation before using recognizable-model images for training.

findings.evidenceSummary: Adult-restricted album says the photographs depict the account owner, were taken either by himself or guest photographers, and are licensed CC BY-SA 3.0.
findings.rightsFinding: Adult/self-subject evidence is strong, but guest-photographer wording prevents assuming the account owner holds copyright for every individual image. Exact work-level authorship must be resolved before use.
findings.nextAction: Identify exact self-photographed works and verify work-level authorship before local intake.

findings.creator: Vishal Rastogi / Creative Bloke Photography
findings.evidenceSummary: Modern 2026 studio work explicitly describes a shirtless male model and is visually close to contemporary Artes portrait photography.
findings.rightsFinding: No sufficiently clear training-compatible copyright license, adult-status evidence or model/personality-rights authorization was established for the reviewed work.
findings.nextAction: Style reference only unless direct permission is obtained.

findings.creator: Scott Beale / Laughing Squid
findings.evidenceSummary: Flickr pages explicitly state Creative Commons licensing for event photography, including kink-adjacent material.
findings.rightsFinding: Exact license details and especially individual model/personality rights are insufficient for recognizable people in a moderation-training corpus. Material is also visually dated for Artes calibration.
findings.nextAction: Do not promote; use only as evidence that public kink photography remains model-rights constrained.

conclusion.mainConstraint: recognizable-human adulthood/model-rights evidence rather than image copyright alone
conclusion.recommendedNextRoute: Continue direct-permission/contributor-authorized sourcing while keeping public CC candidates as research leads.
